### Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood — game guide

Walkthrough of the tactical strategy game *Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood*, in which we have the opportunity to command an elite band of outcasts led, naturally, by the legendary Robin Hood.

#### Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood — game guide

*Caption:* “Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood” is another game inspired by the memorable *COMMANDOS* — *Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood — game guide*.

*Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood* is another game inspired by the memorable *COMMANDOS*. Built on the *DESPERADOS* engine, it offers us several interesting innovations. At first glance, it does not differ much from the adventures of the heroes of the Wild West, but after just a few missions a vast gulf between the two products becomes apparent. Robin Hood is a LEGENDARY subject—well known, with no dynamic, surprising plot twists to expect—so the game loses a little in terms of its story. It is a very relaxed “stealth” tactical game; if you feel like completing a mission by force, nothing prevents you from doing so, although that is not always advantageous. The heroes with whom you will have the pleasure of completing the game possess many interesting abilities, quite different from firing rifles or sniper rifles, or luring people with a decoy or cigarettes. Some of them, such as archery and hand-to-hand combat, can be improved by leaving a hero in Sherwood and ordering training. Useful items are also produced in Sherwood, such as arrows, herbs, food, and so on. These are only some of the new features in *Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood*; I suggest that interested players discover the rest for themselves. The game is certainly worth spending a few hours on. Have a pleasant romp through the forests of Sherwood…

[Next: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood — Lincoln](https://www.gry-online.pl/poradniki/robin-hood-legenda-sherwood/lincoln/zbf4a)

### Lincoln

![Lincoln guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/5528875.png "Finding Godwin — Lincoln guide map")

The aim of this mission is to find Godwin, a good friend of our hero’s father and Robin’s godfather. You begin outside Lincoln’s walls in shabby clothing. This is a training mission that introduces the game and the hero’s abilities. For practice, duel the guard by the gate. The scrolls you encounter explain the purpose of items and provide small hints. Use the green vines on the wall or an agile jump from the roof to reach the walls and collect arrows. Shoot the targets at which the enemy archers have been trying to hit for some time; after your accurate shot they will go to eat. Descend to the square where the targets are displayed [2] and pick up the scroll. You will notice a pouch dropped by one of the archers. Give the beggar a few coppers and he will point out the roof where another scroll lies. When you pick it up, a room containing a throwable pouch will be revealed; reach it using the vines.

Return to the target square [2] and approach the group of soldiers staring at a woman. Pick up the scroll near them to reveal another pouch, then throw it among the soldiers. When they have fought, knock out the winner with a quick blow if necessary and take the arrows. Use the stairs nearest the beggar to reach the walls when the guard there has his back turned, and strike him. The walls lead to one of the castle doors; enter through it. One soldier is inside, so stun him when his back is turned. Through the door on the left, go to room [3], where you meet Edward, Godwin’s loyal servant. He tells you that he does not know where Godwin is and warns you about danger from the sheriff of Nottingham.

Edward’s son is waiting in the village west of the castle. Leave by the same route, descend through the small tower to the room where you found the first pouch, and use the vines to return to the place where this stage began. Knock down the soldier by the well and climb the stairs to the walls. Follow them to the gate tower [1] and lower the drawbridge. Once outside the castle walls, you will see a patrolling guard in the lower-left corner. Approach and stun him when he turns. A little higher stands another soldier, this one stationary; give him a right hook. Another is chasing a woman, so end his courtship when he turns his back. Pick up the arrows and pouch, then throw the pouch among the four soldiers by the bridge and finish any survivor if necessary. The road to Edward’s son is clear.

### Nottingham

![Nottingham guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6258687.png "Stuteley and his men are to be hanged — Nottingham guide map")

Stuteley and his men are going to be hanged for opposing the sheriff of Nottingham. We must prevent this and free our companions. First pick up the pouch lying directly in front of you. Then approach the beggar from the left, so the guards at the gate [1] do not see you, and give the poor man a few coins. Walk up to the sleeping guard at the gate and give him a quick straight punch; do the same to the second guard on the right. Pick up the scroll, which reveals a group of guards watching the condemned prisoners. Once through the gate, you will see three soldiers by the well on the left and one patrolling straight ahead. When the patrolman turns, approach and strike him. Now show your archery skills: shoot the first soldier on the right. The three soldiers standing at the stocks [2] will run toward you; shoot them as well. The archer will go for reinforcements, so run after him and shoot him. Another archer may appear among the soldiers he passed, so kill him too. Finally, another would-be archer will run up from below; one arrow is enough.

Free your companions and take the arrows. Several blue scrolls will appear around the stocks, describing the abilities of each newly acquired friend. Tell Stuteley to bind the stunned soldier on the left. Matt carries a large club with which he can stun an opponent, making him very useful against several enemies at once. Run him to the group of soldiers in the alley on the right and attack the archer first. Have Stuteley bind them, then use Robin or Arthur to collect the arrows. The alley on the left, opposite the alley where the arrows were, has another patrol; disable its soldier. A little higher stands another enemy. Remove him when the five-man group patrolling the square in front of the cathedral [3] cannot see him. Again use Matt’s club to knock down the five soldiers and then bind them. If Matt has suffered serious injuries, attack the three soldiers standing beside the well by gate [1] with everyone. You will find herbs there, which Pete can use to heal his companions. A pouch lies beside the cathedral’s smaller entrance, and more herbs are in the small cemetery behind the cathedral. A little above the square, beside a house, a soldier faces the square. Hide Robin behind the building’s corner and stun him without letting him call the cathedral knight. Two more soldiers stand just above him with their backs turned, so they are easy to remove. When the second enemy is disabled, the soldier below the wall will see it; deal with him with your sword when he runs over. A patrol moves through the parallel alley; Matt is ideal for it, but remember to attack the archers first. Take the ham with Matt, then have Robin climb the walls and hit the guard.

Go left to the tower at the north gate [4], where an archer is stationed, and neutralize him. Collect the arrows beside the second tower on the wall, then return to the square with the gallows [2]. The alley below leads to stairs up to the walls. A couple is talking beside the stairs; approach with Robin and stun them, because they will call for help if they see you. There is a garden beside them, with an apple that Stuteley or Pete can take. Use Robin or Arthur to collect the arrows in the tower by gate [1]. Beside the gate’s well is a ramp leading to gate [5] and the castle courtyard; from the ramp you can jump onto the roof where more arrows lie. Head toward gate [1], the entrance by which you entered Nottingham. The two guards there are easily finished by the whole group.

Two soldiers are talking to the left of the gate. Sneak up with Robin, shoot the archer, and attack the remaining soldiers with everyone. After defeating all the men at the stocks, stun the sleeping guard by prison gate [6]. Lead the entire group onto the prison roof through the small door, eliminate the soldiers there, and collect the arrows. Approach the enemy group by the huts below the gallows with Matt, stun and bind them, beginning with the archers. Watch for the knight by the bridge and finish him with the whole party. An archer stands by the arrows in the lower-left corner; stun him and take the arrows. Pick up the apple beside the hut to the right of the bridge. Then have Matt stun the two soldiers tormenting a woman in the enclosure in front of the house and take the meat. In the lower-right corner, two soldiers and a tax collector stand beside a hut; finish them, for example with Matt, and take the money. That should be everything available in this area. The things you collected will help in later stages. Gather everyone and return to Sherwood.

### Sherwood Forest

At your headquarters you can produce the things needed for later missions and train your people. Unfortunately, to produce anything you must leave allies in camp. Once you have assigned everyone a task, set out on a mission. Your tasks are divided into larger missions and ambushes. I will not describe ambushes because they often repeat and follow a pattern. A few tips may help:

- Robin and his bow are entirely sufficient for the first ambushes, so it is better to assign the other companions work in camp.
- Shields hanging from trees call members of the merry company to help you. Some shields activate traps.
- Do not finish off everyone on the map if you can outwit the enemy and, for example, steal their gold.
- Try to make maximum use of the help provided by your hidden companions.

### Confession of an Outlaw

![Confession of an Outlaw guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6303812.png "Find Marion — Confession of an Outlaw guide map")

You must find Marion. First clear a path to the beggar, who will certainly give you a clue for a few coppers. Choose at least three members of the band for this mission. One must be able to carry bodies (for example Matt), and another must be able to bind enemies (for example Stuteley). The action takes place at night. At the start you meet a woman mourning her son, who opposed the sheriff and was killed. Two soldiers stand to the right of her house; Matt can easily stun them. Remember to bind enemies after every knockout. Continue right, then up, cross the bridge beside the mill [1], and hide behind the house. Two guards stand in front of the hut behind which you are hiding. Knock them out with Robin, bind them, and hide their bodies in the building. A soldier stands to the left of the building facing gate [2]. Approach the building with Matt and whistle; when the soldier runs over, stun him, bind him, and carry him into the hut. Now deal with the guards at gate [2]. Whistle from a distance at which no more than two guards can hear you. When they notice you, retreat toward the building where the bodies are hidden, stun and bind the enemies there, and hide them. Take care that the archers on the walls do not hear your whistle. Cross gate [2] with all three characters. Stun and bind the archer standing by the entrance and attack the sergeant slightly above him. None of the soldiers will notice you; carry the body to the ground beside the well.

Several enemies stand in the square: three by the castle approach [3], one by the buildings, and one by the stocks [4]. A patrol of five soldiers and two archers also circles there, stopping just before the square with the empty stocks [4]. When the patrol stops, throw a pouch beneath the door to its left. All nearby soldiers will run over and fight. With luck only one will remain; run up and disable him. Bind everyone and, just in case, hide the bodies. Two enemies stand to the right of the stocks [4]; approach with Matt, stun them, and bind them. Give some coins to the beggar sitting by the castle approach [3]. The scroll he points out tells you that Marion is dining with the sheriff. A sergeant stands beside the tower near the scroll; remove him, then knock down the knight walking beside the chapel [5]. Give the beggar more coins—doing so several times does no harm. A scroll appears beside the chapel; it reveals the hiding place of money belonging to the sheriff’s brother-in-law. Four soldiers stand a little above the chapel; three juggle balls to entertain a woman. Approach as close as possible with Matt and attack with a spinning strike. You should knock down everyone except the sergeant; hit him once more. Pick up the scroll in the alley to learn about another beggar. Go to him, eliminating the guards on the walls on the way. He tells you that Marion confesses every evening in the church [5]. Go there, stun the friar, hide him in the sacristy, and have Robin enter the confessional.

After meeting Marion you must escape Nottingham. Before leaving, you can rob the sheriff’s brother-in-law and take the body of the boy from stocks [6] to the woman whose son was killed. Three soldiers stand outside the brother-in-law’s house; remove them, then use Stuteley to open the locked door and take the gold. Now deal with the soldiers by stocks [6] outside Nottingham’s walls. Approach with Matt so the soldier on the right notices and attacks. After knocking him down and binding him, tell Robin to stun the second soldier; Matt should deal with the two standing on the road to Sherwood. Free the boy’s body from the stocks and carry it to his mother, preferably along the road you have already cleared. Then return to Sherwood!

### Scarlet Night

![Scarlet Night guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6323937.png "Scarlet Will has been captured — Scarlet Night guide map")

Scarlet Will, your nephew, has been captured. You must free him. Choose the trio that completed the previous mission. Run Matt to the bridge in front of the castle and attack the guards, then attack the patrol arriving from the right. A few spinning blows will deal with them. Two more nuisances will run up shortly; after removing them, go right and finish three more by the mill [1]. Speak to the boy beside the mill; he asks you to help a beggar. Around the middle of the map’s right side is a stone bridge with a soldier beside it. Approach correctly with Robin and you can stun him without trouble. Follow the riverbank to the second stone bridge, where another soldier stands, and stun him. Remember to bind each temporarily incapacitated enemy after every knockout. Return to the first bridge along the opposite bank and stun the soldier standing on its far side.

Matt must deal with the three soldiers tormenting the beggar. Give the beggar several coins and he will point out several scroll locations. The nearest is immediately beside the building by the bridge. Go to it, eliminating the sergeant on the way. The scroll tells you where Will is held [2]. Now go below the mill [1] in the lower-right corner. A scroll with a hint lies by the river. Use the stone in the river to reach the fortress wall and begin climbing the vines. Strike the soldier guarding the wall and follow the wall left until you reach the room containing the mechanism that opens gate [3]. Open the way for your friends into the courtyard.

Continue left and stun the archer. In the courtyard beside the gate is a building with a guard in front. Slip your people unnoticed through the door behind the guard. Stun the sleeping soldier and pick up the scroll, which tells you about a large amount of money in tower [4] at the top of the map; deal with that in a moment. Now strike the soldier guarding the balcony. Have Matt go to the upper floor of tower [2] and beat the enemies there. Stuteley opens the locked hatch leading to the basement where Will is held. After freeing him, he tells you about a secret passage [5] that can be used to escape the fortification. Have Robin stun the guard before the door and Matt hide the body. Use the same technique on the soldier to the left of the large doors of building [6] in the center of the map, though this requires some dexterity. At the top of the wooden stairs behind the stone entrance is a soldier; shoot him with the bow. Have Matt finish everyone inside the room reached by the stairs. Robin should strike the enemy guarding the walls, while Matt beats the soldiers guarding the valuables in tower [4]. Take the gold and descend to the courtyard.

Will is ideal for stunning the group of soldiers patrolling the courtyard. His next victims can be the soldiers on the right side: four in all—two by Will’s secret passage [5], one by the stone entrance, and one by the drawbridge on the right. Once the enemies are gone, lower the bridge. A scroll on the lowest level of the tower tells you about arrows on the highest level of the neighboring tower. You will have to disable several nuisances to obtain the quivers. Finally pick up the scroll lying on the ground to the right of central building [6]. It says that the passage leads to one of the houses. Use the passage and return to headquarters.

### The Prince and the Outlaw

![The Prince and the Outlaw guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6350375.png "Prince John arrives in Derby — guide map")

Prince John has arrived in Derby. Marion proposes arranging a meeting, but the prince will not speak to an outlaw, so you must reach him secretly. Choose Lady Marion, Matt, and Stuteley. Approach the guards at gate [1] without being seen; stun the one on the right, bind him, and carry him somewhere soldiers cannot see. Pick up the scroll. Pay the beggar several times and he will reveal useful clues. A group of soldiers stands by the rebuilt tower; a full gold pouch is an ideal way to make them fight. Knock out the survivor, then do the same to the second gate guard. Have Stuteley bind the fallen group and collect the scroll. Climb the walls and disable the soldier there. Watch the crossbowman patrolling almost the whole wall: follow him upward, wait until he pauses by the soldier staring left, then stun the crossbowman between the two soldiers and stun both soldiers afterward.

Three scrolls lie by the stairs—one on the wall and two on the ground. Collect them and shoot the sleeping guard from the nearby wall. Descend with Matt and whistle when the patrol by the houses is far enough away. The guards before entrance [2] to the main courtyard will run to you; strike them with the club and bind them. From the well before the entrance, have Robin shoot the guard on the wall by entrance [3] to the second courtyard; his vision includes the boy lying with the woman. Carefully move the whole party to the woman and boy, collecting herbs. The knight by the cottage stairs should not notice you. Speak to the woman and have Marion heal the boy, then Matt stun and bind the knight. Strike two more wall guards and enter the room connecting the walls.

On the left, stun the soldier when he walks with his back to you. On the right are three guards, two stationary and one patrolling. Step as close as possible to his vision and attack when he turns, ignoring the others; if you time it correctly and do not run, the courtyard patrol will not notice. Deal with the stationary guards and bind them. At the right moment descend and cross the courtyard to the opposite stairs. Ignore the knight sitting by the money and the archers on the wall. Shoot the guard by the side door of Prince John’s building. Crouch along the wall toward gate [2] to the main courtyard, approach the soldier at the wall corner without being seen by the patrol below, stun and bind him, then cross through the room above gate [2].

Four enemies remain there—three stationary and one wall patrol. When the patrol reaches the soldier by the stairs, approach and stun both, ignoring the stationary men; return for the others, stun and bind them, and watch the patrol below. Hide in the building after picking up the scroll. On roof [4], wait until the sergeant faces away from the door and a soldier stands on the turret above it; exit, stun the turret soldier, and crouch immediately. A stone bridge connects the castle roofs; beyond it are a crossbowman and two guards. Watch the crossbowman’s route. When he walks to the higher balcony, stun the guard by the bridge and shoot the guard by the door as quickly as possible. Follow the crossbowman onto the balcony and deal with him.

Enter room [5] with Robin and Marion, where Prince John is waiting. The supposed ally is a traitor, so you must escape Derby. Outside, pick up the scroll beside the door; it reveals that John keeps the scepter in room [6]. Before going there, climb tower [7] through the adjacent door, observe the soldier’s patrol, and steal the money without being seen or heard. Return by the same route to room [6]. Five soldiers and one knight are inside, but only one soldier moves. When he turns his back to the entrance, hide Robin behind the door leading to the roof. Wait until the soldier approaches and stun him. Bring Matt in, approach the seated knight, and attack; when he rises, draw an eight in combat to knock him down. Several spinning attacks should finish the remaining hostile units. Take the scepter and return to the mission start; you should not need force on the way. Return to Sherwood.

### Rescue

![Rescue guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6441343.png "Help the peasants — Rescue guide map")

Help the peasants stop the soldiers’ abuses. Speak to the people beside you, then approach the soldiers at the left edge of the map on the road by the large rocks. Stun them in order, starting with the archer by the boulders, then the knight, then the rest; they should not notice you. Bind them and speak to the woman walking among the trees just below [1]; she is looking for her son Peter. Several enemies are in the lower-left. Hide among the trees and throw a pouch so the juggling archer also hears the coins. When the fight produces a winner, approach and congratulate him with a fist. Two enemies by the pen entrance will notice you; wait for them to run over and beat them. Several soldiers by the tree in the pen should also notice and approach; bind them after defeating them.

Hide behind the tree in the pen. Several soldiers stand beside the haystack [2]. Step out, throw a pouch among them, and hide again. When they have fought, finish the winner and bind everyone. Speak to the woman [2] whom the soldiers tormented; she asks you to help her husband at [3], to the right of the starting point. Before going there, throw a pouch from behind the fence among the soldiers at crossroads [4]. When the sergeant calms them, run up, hit them with the club, and bind them. Wait until the soldiers patrolling above notice you, then stun them as they run over. Help the oppressed man surrounded by four archers and a sergeant by approaching from the left edge. Shoot the archers and beat the sergeant and any reinforcements. The freed man tells you that the prisoner in the upper-right [5] is Little John; take the clover he gives you in thanks.

Move behind the trees along the upper edge to the mounted knight. Several archers are nearby, but stun only the one closest to the rider and facing Little John. Return to the pen by the crossroads along the same route, speaking on the way to the boy playing among the trees near crossroads [6]. He is Peter, the missing child of the woman at [1]. Tell her you found him. Near the haystack, wait for the archer to appear among the trees across the road; stun him when his back is turned, then immediately shoot the archer by the wooden barriers on the right. Stun the knight by the clover and take it. Remove the two guards and soldier near Little John [5] without alerting the rider. A knight will leave the cottage when you try to free your companion. If the conversation makes him difficult to defeat, attack immediately as he exits; this gives a few seconds for a special eight-shaped attack. Once he is down, have Little John boost Robin onto the roof with the money. Then return to Sherwood.

### Evening Guest

![Evening Guest guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6468109.png "Reach Ranulph’s chamber — guide map")

Reach Ranulph’s chamber [1] without harming any of his men. Two soldiers stand by the stream at the start; one is periodically visited by a sergeant. When the sergeant is away, Robin should stun both enemies. Hide the bodies with Little John and knock down the sergeant when he returns. Robin should stun and bind the juggling archer. Go right and stun the two enemies facing upward. A guard stands before the northernmost cottage; when he is outside the sight of the nearby enemies, run up with John, stun him, and hide him in the house. Hide behind the cottage with the beggar. Observe the sergeant’s route: walking toward the castle, he stops just beyond the stone bridge by the beggar. This is the ideal moment for John to stun him and hide him behind the house. Have Robin stun the guard at the right edge by the bridge. Bind everyone you stun.

By the water mill [2], an archer circles the second stone bridge. When he walks downward, approach with Robin and strike him. Give the beggar coins several times; he will point out scrolls with useful clues. Below the mill bridge is a pen patrolled by a knight. Have John follow the moat’s edge and approach the knight from behind, strike him, and bind him. A woman and man stand before the nearby cottage; use Marion’s spy ability. If they see you they will fetch soldiers, so stun them with Robin. Enter the pen and stun the guard by building [3], ideally while the patrolling crossbowman is walking toward the juggling archer. Hide the body, then stun the returning crossbowman. Pick up the scroll by the mill before entering. Carry the body and enter the building with the secret passage [3] with the whole party. Pick up the scroll. The patrolling sergeant stops just before the stone exit, so John can stun and hide him. Two archers stand by the stone entrance: one by the wall, the other moving between the stairs to tower [4] and the wooden walkway. Pay the beggar for important information. Remove the wall archer when the other is on the walkway, hide his body, and do the same to the second when possible.

Take the stairs beside the secret passage to tower [2]. One guard is sleeping and another is staring out of the window; Robin can knock both down and take the pouch. Study the guards on the walls by the wooden walkway. One barely moves, while the other patrols the entire wall through a room. John should deal with the first while the second is away, preferably when he is near the walkway. Hide the body, then have Robin strike the second guard. Cross through the room to the other side of the walls and knock down the guard there. Use the same room to descend and stun the archer by the door. Return along the walls toward the beggar. Robin should stun the two guards before building [5] in the middle of the map and another near the wooden stairs. Bind everyone you stun.

Contact Ralph [1] with Marion and Robin. He will help, but cannot tell his men, so you must escape the castle yourself. A guard stands before the building leading to western tower [6]. John should stun him while watching the soldier near main gate [7]. Hide the body and eliminate the gate enemy when he is heading toward the gate. Have Robin enter the building leading to the eastern tower. In the corridor, stun the first guard, then the second by the money; he will not notice your approach. Take the coins and remove the crossbowman on the balcony connecting the building to tower [6]. Use Marion’s spy ability to learn who is on the tower’s upper floor. When the sergeant is by the window, have John stun him. Take the Book of the Last Judgment, then return to Sherwood through the secret passage.

### Godfather Imprisoned

![Godfather Imprisoned guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6488359.png "Free Godwin — guide map")

Take Robin, Stuteley, and Little John. You must free Godwin from the dungeon [1]. Have Little John deal with the soldiers harassing a poor peasant; as compensation you receive a clover. A beggar sits by a hut at the left edge of the map; ask him for information, collect the clues, cross the bridge, and follow the road. Three enemies stand by the river; stun them with Little John’s club and bind them. Continue until you meet another group and disable them with John as well. Follow the lower edge until you meet a soldier patrolling the lower-right area. Stun him and go up toward eastern gate [2], where you remove another enemy. Use Robin and Stuteley to climb the vines to the walls, preferably when the guard is at the right edge of the screen. Stun and bind him. Walk along the walls toward gate [2] and stun the guards on the two towers above it, binding every incapacitated enemy. Have Robin jump from the wall dividing the courtyards onto the hut roof. Descend carefully past patrols and stun the two guards near the eastern gate. Stuteley should climb down the vines and bind the fallen enemies.

Take both heroes to the hut roof where Robin landed, then climb its vines to the stone balcony leading to the room with money. Take the money, leave through the room’s stairs to the walls, and stun the guard on watch. Follow the walls upward to room [3] with three soldiers; slip unnoticed to the left-hand door without attacking. Enter dining hall [4], where a sergeant and two soldiers are present, and pass into the next room without provoking them. A knight sits there; approach from behind and use the special eight-shaped attack. Take the money, go onto the balcony, and remove the guard. Descend one level through the door and return to the walls. Guisbourne will flee through a secret passage, leaving you to free Godwin [1]. Continue left along the walls, descend two floors, and stun the soldier there. Check the vision of the guard before Godwin’s cell, then descend at the right moment and stun the two enemies in the dungeon. Have Stuteley open the cells and speak to Godwin. He identifies where his allies are imprisoned; freeing them helps clear the castle. The first reinforcements are one floor above. After freeing them, run ahead and free the next allies. Help them, because they cannot manage alone; sergeants cause them particular trouble, so deal with those yourself. When the route to southern gate [5] is clear, lower the drawbridge so John can cause a commotion. Stunning the last enemy inside the castle completes the mission.

### Little Brother’s Mishap

![Little Brother’s Mishap guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6509828.png "Little Brother’s Mishap — guide map")

Take Robin, Little John, and Stuteley. First approach the soldiers by the unfinished tower with John, attack them, and bind them. Speak to one of the nearby peasants, then climb the walls. Robin should stun the soldiers there: two are looking around and one patrols the upper wall. Soldiers on the courtyard side should notice you and run up; if they do not, provoke them by running John along the walls. When they arrive, stun and bind them. Shoot or lure the guard standing left of gate [1], whose drawbridge is raised and who faces the stairs you must descend. When the large courtyard patrol moves to its lower section, slip all your people behind the hut where the beggar sits, watching the soldier by the well. Stun the crossbowman and soldier talking at southern gate [2], preferably with John’s club. Hide the bodies behind the hut and bind them. Pay the beggar, pick up the nearby clue, and stun the guard by the stairs. Place his body beside the peasant who asks for food.

Four archers and two soldiers stand on the right wall. First Robin should stun the soldier beside the stairs. Ignore the soldier by the higher door; when he notices you, attack and kill him—no enemy should react. Have Stuteley open the door above gate [3] leading to the smaller courtyard. Enter with Robin and wait for the guard who patrols from the wall through the courtyard and back to approach the right-hand wall door; knock him down with the sword. Stun the two guards on the right-hand wall. Have Robin free the little brother, then descend the tower to the small courtyard, pass unseen by the enemies at the well, and stun the sleeping soldier. Approach the soldiers by the well from behind and strike at an angle so one knocks the other down. Quickly stun and bind the second, then move both bodies somewhere safe.

Shoot the shield that lowers the bridge between the stairs and the wall. Hide Robin in dining hall [4] and wait for the guard to come to the door. When he turns, stun him and hide again. Enter the dining hall with everyone and collect the meat. Have John go onto the roof, stun the knight there, and take the money from the turret. Descend to the courtyard, approach the sergeant from behind with John, and stun him. Next deal with the guard before the stair door; move his body immediately because one of the four archers on the wall can see it. Three enemies remain in the courtyard; remove them with Robin and his pouch. Bind them, climb the right wall, and cross to the wall with the archers.

Deal with the soldier above gate [3] between the courtyards and hide his body. Throw a pouch among the wall archers and hide. When only one remains, approach and strike him. The soldier to the right of gate [1] with the large raised drawbridge will notice you; wait calmly until he runs over and defeat him with the sword. If the guard beside the archers does not hear the coins, stun and bind him separately. Follow the walls to the room above gate [1], collect the quiver, and continue left. Two guards stand there: stun the one on the wall and wait for the one by the door to run to you, then kill him. Pick up the clue scroll. Bring John and Stuteley, enter the castle with everyone, and watch for the archer who periodically looks toward the doors. John should stun the guard on roof [5] by the door. Attack the three soldiers on the bridge between the castle roofs, bind them, and deal with two more on the far side of the stone bridge. Have John stun the knight in tower [6], who guards a valuable spoon; take it and descend. Enter Prince John’s chamber [7]. You learn that Godwin’s estate is about to be attacked. Warn him by returning to Sherwood, preferably along the route you have already cleared.

You must help Godwin defend his fortress. There are three ways to do so: exchange companions from Sherwood for the shields needed for victory; buy a shield with the money your companions collected; or complete a mission that rewards you with the required shield.

### Black Castle

![Black Castle guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6533937.png "Attack on Derby — guide map")

Ranulph has decided that it is time to attack Derby. You must help him, and as in the Defense of Lincoln you need shields, obtained in the same ways as before. The difference is that you must actively take part in the assault on Derby. The task is to eliminate every enemy, so it should not be difficult. Use Robin and his bow to remove as many archers and crossbowmen as possible, and have Little John fight in close combat. Stuteley’s binding ability is useful here. After clearing the first and second courtyards, shorten the mission by passing through Prince John’s chamber—familiar from The Prince and the Outlaw or Little Brother’s Mishap—using the side doors [1] to reach the castle roof. Eliminate the enemies there, then use Robin to climb tower [2], where Scathlock, one of Prince John’s best generals, is stationed. Defeating him completes the mission successfully.

### Silver Arrow

![Silver Arrow guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6549671.png "Archery tournament — guide map")

An archery tournament has been announced at Nottingham Castle; the prize is a silver arrow and a kiss from beautiful Marion. Robin cannot miss the chance to meet his love, but must undertake the mission alone, at least initially. After your accurate shot at the target, the sheriff recognizes you and a sword duel is unavoidable. After a few good blows he flees with his two knights. Run to Marion on balcony [1], left of the castle’s main entrance. She tells you that the archer you competed against was very interested in you and escaped over the walls by an unusual route you can use. Wait on the balcony until the courtyard quiets, then reach the place where your tournament rival jumped the wall, removing the wall guard on the way.

On the other side, the rival offers help, joins the merry company, and promises help from his cousins in Nottingham. Soldiers search for Robin and may wander onto your wall. When the moment is safe, have Robin stun the three guards on the walls and bind them with Much the Miller. Return to the courtyard and speak to the beggar, who gives clues. Two are nearby—one by the well and one by the approach to gate [2]; collect them and return to the walls over southern gate [3]. Stun and bind another guard, descend the stairs, and attack the three soldiers guarding the sheriff’s brother-in-law’s house. With a well-timed attack you can stun two and simply kill the third from the stairs.

Cross the roofs to one of Much’s cousins. With the newly recruited companion, go to the right side of the stocks square [4] and attack the soldier by the round building. Peter’s pitchfork is effective when used from the enemy’s side. Nearby soldiers will attack; knock them down and bind them. A woman panics and calls reinforcements, but Peter can stun the arriving group. Collect the clue scrolls before the huts above stocks [4]. Free the peasant in the stocks. If the woman runs for help after seeing your people or bound enemies, hide in a hut and stun and bind her when she appears on the square. Remove the sergeant whose men you have just defeated.

Go up the road on the right of the stocks. Two guards stand by the cathedral’s side entrance [5], one asleep; approach with Peter and stun them with the pitchfork. A guard circles before the main church entrance; step into his sight when he approaches to provoke an attack, then defeat him. Watch the sergeant and four archers patrolling left of the cathedral. When they move toward gate [6], run up with Peter and attack; one hit is enough to stun an archer. Bind the stunned enemies, then approach the knight sitting in the wall recess with Peter. Immediately draw repeated stunning blows to win unharmed. Two guards from gate [6] will run over, and another troublesome woman is nearby; bind her when possible. Have Robin climb the wall and stun the guard left of gate [6].

Have Peter enter the room leading to the right-hand walls, first studying the guards’ patrols. Exit just after the knight turns, stun the guard by the door, and, if necessary, the one approaching from the opposite side. Slip past the knight and recruit Bolder the Colossus. Take Bolder back onto the wall and defeat the knight; a thrust followed by an attack works best. With Bolder, hide all bodies near the balcony where the sergeant and soldiers stand. Have Robin throw a money pouch beneath the balcony; some guards will fight over it. Finish the remaining soldiers and sergeant, and bind them.

Now deal with the Sword of the Nation and his escort in cathedral [5]. Put Bolder before the main entrance and have Robin shoot the guards by the doorway. Whenever one exits, attack with Bolder. After clearing the cathedral, take the sword and go for the silver arrow and Marion. Soldiers may resist on the way after another woman raises the alarm. Have Bolder collect the scroll under gate [2], attack the courtyard guards and the sergeant on the stairs, then deal with the silver arrow’s escort. Take the arrow and use the walls left of the gate to remove the enemies preventing Marion from leaving the balcony. Bind everyone stunned nearby.

Optionally deal with the tax collector and his men harassing peasants at the lower-left [7]. Remove the soldiers and sergeant by the two huts near the single-pig pen, then beat the collector’s gang with Bolder. Avoid the riders, and have Robin stun and rob the collector. You may also take the money in the upper-right [8], guarded by a knight and two soldiers; approach the turret door so the lower enemies run out and attack. Return to Sherwood.

### Wedding or Funeral

![Wedding or Funeral guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6617125.png "Stop Marion’s wedding — guide map")

You must prevent Marion’s marriage to Guisbern, to whom Prince John has given Robin’s beloved. John and Stuteley are indispensable. Speak to the beggar before the starting house [1]. Stun the peasant who stops at the corner of the house above. Beware similarly dressed people and women from earlier missions: if they see you, they call guards. Disable the guard at the left edge level with the stunned peasant, bind everyone, and hide them in a building. Pick up the scroll at the crossroads. With Little John go right to the sergeant speaking with a woman; avoid the nearby soldier, stun the sergeant, then the woman, then the soldier. Bind and hide all bodies. Study the patrol on the city’s right, then approach the beggar by the house slightly right and ask for clues. Return to square [1], stun the next peasant watching three soldiers by the crossroads, and, when the sergeant and his eight men are safely away, attack the three with John. Bind and hide them.

Cross the crossroads to the right. A sergeant stands beside the beggar; evade his vision and stun him with John. Give the beggar money until he says “last advice.” Pick up the scroll across the road. Approach the peasant it identifies from behind, stun him, and carry him away. Stun the black knight and the woman flirting with him, bind them, and take the Ampulla, another crown jewel. Next deal with the merchant who ruined a beggar. His house is right of the last beggar; he walks between it and three soldiers. When he returns from the soldiers and faces his house, approach with Robin, stun him, and rob him. At bridge [2] a tall building has three enemies; approach from behind, attack with John, hide them in the wooden shed, and bind them.

Take Robin and Little John onto bridge [2]. Two archers, a sergeant, and soldiers stand across it. Robin shoots the archers while John attacks the rest. Bind and hide bodies by the building opposite locked gate [3]. Throw Robin’s pouch among the archers from the square’s stairs, as close to the bank as possible, not from the bridge. Guards from across the river will join the fight. Finish the winner and bind everyone. Descend to the water and follow the ice path toward the large stone arch. At the ice’s end are a scroll and secret passage [4]. Take Robin, Stuteley, and John through it. Stun the soldier by the fort wall stairs, then enter the room with the knight guarding the money pouch. Stun him and the soldier in the round room. Clear the wall soldiers as well. Before changing the flag, open gate [3] using the lever in the turret right of it. Send Stuteley and John outside, neutralize the four enemies at the pier with the scroll, bind and hide them, then stun the guards on the walls of the closed north gate [6].

Use the tower left of the gate to reach the church courtyard [7]. Remove the enemy by the stairs and the one nearby, bind and hide them, then return with Stuteley and John to starting square [1]. Hide in a building on the main road to the church. Have Robin change flag [5]. Everyone below the church will run toward York’s exit gates. Take Robin from the tower to the walls, jump to the roof with the scroll, and from there to the walls by north gate [6]. Cross the towers beside the gate to the church courtyard [7]. Little John attacks the remaining troops before the church, beginning with the archers; Stuteley binds them while Robin enters the church. Duel Guisbern there with quick blows, since spins and special attacks rarely work. After defeating him, leave York quickly: go to square [1] at the left edge, collect the healing herb, and descend to southern exit [8]. Several enemies guard it; attack with John when the sergeant and his eight-man patrol are safely away. Once they fall, leave York.

### March on York

![March on York guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6784296.png "Offensive against York — guide map")

This is another offensive move by our allies, and we must help our people. Buy or obtain shields and set out for York. Be sure to include Marion; her healing ability will be very useful. Allied soldiers cannot enter York until you clear the way. First deal with the eastern entrance gate [1]. Then attack the church [2], preferably along the left edge of the map. Signal the allied units to attack by ringing the church bell. Once all enemies in your path are gone, follow the walls to the north gate [3]. Deal with the soldiers in front of the fort, then use, for example, Will to reach the fort from the walls. Eliminate everyone inside and open gate [4], or reach the tower and change the flag [5]. Once you have obtained the required number of shields, the stage ends.

For York’s defense, exchange money or people for shields, or complete missions that reward them. Only three shields are needed to defend York, so it will not be expensive.

### Final Challenge

![Final Challenge guide map](https://cdn.gracza.pl/galeria/Html/Poradniki/185/6809812.png "Final mission in Nottingham — guide map")

Prince John has retreated to Nottingham, where the final mission takes place. When selecting the team, pay attention to the order in which characters are chosen. It is best to choose Little John and Stuteley last; they will then begin at the north gate [1]. Approach the gate with John to provoke the guards. When they run over, stun and bind the enemies. Then approach the guards at the gate from the town side, lure them outside Nottingham’s walls, and stun them. Watch the civilian informer near the gate and the archer on the tower. Have Stuteley open the locked tower door. Take John onto the higher tower and stun the crossbowmen there. If you hide their bodies quickly, the soldier on the wall to the tower’s right will notice nothing; if you do not have time, eliminate him.

Move to the lower tower, climb onto the walls, and stun the archers. Step outside the tower and strike the sergeant standing there, then hide his body in the tower. Remember to bind every stunned enemy. Follow the walls left of gate [1] to tower [2], where two quivers and meat lie; if you cannot find the tower door, press left Shift. Have John stun the archers drinking there, then go to the prison level and finish the guard before the cell door. Another nuisance will run in from outside, so deal with him too. A clover lies in the cell. Return to the walls and stun the three nearest archers on the right. Descend to the courtyard and stun the two guards by the stairs. Two soldiers stand at the castle’s main entrance [3]; deal with them as well. Two more by the left-hand stairs will attack while you do so. Once everyone is beaten and bound, move the bodies—preferably to the prison—and have Stuteley open the main entrance [3]. Then open the gate with the lever in the turret to its right [4].

A group of black soldiers and a sergeant will enter the courtyard. When they stand before the castle entrance and the sergeant goes inside, have Little John stun the two guards at gate [4], then two more by the gate approach beside Robin. Return John and Robin to the courtyard. Robin should shoot the guard and three archers on the wall by the left-hand stairs; if they notice you, shoot two more in the left tower by the gate. Have Stuteley open the locked door by the stairs, take John onto the balcony, and stun the soldier there. Then Robin shoots the sergeant pacing before the entrance to John’s chamber. Two black knights will run down. An easy method is to engage them with Robin while John stuns them with his fists. Finally defeat the sheriff; the mission and the entire game are complete.

#### Fortis_Bellitus_NPC — 2007-01-26 10:49

Cheats for the game: make sure that during play your character is standing. Now click the crouch/kneel icon—“kneling icon.” Then press [F11] to display the console. You can then type the following codes into the input window for the described effects:

- `GOODLUCK` — adds a clover to the campaign.
- `CASH` — gives more money.
- `BINGO` — gives your characters 999 units of ammunition.
- `IMMUNITY` — your character remains immortal.
- `MERRYMAN` — gives you one “merry man.”
- `TIMELESS` — time stops.
- `PAM` — all enemies become foolish during combat.
- `UNBLIP` — you can see all characters on the map.
- `WINNER` — you win the mission.
